beats.summary: Michael introduces a new traveling salesman, Danny Cordray, to the office.

evidence.snippet: Michael: Everyone, may I have your attention? I would like to introduce you to Mr. Danny Cordray.

beats.summary: Some staff express concerns about Danny stealing clients and taking seats, but Michael defends him.

evidence.snippet: Phyllis: It's not gonna get better; he's gonna steal all of our clients.
Michael: No, no. Wrong. He would have stolen your clients, but you know what? He can't now.

beats.summary: Danny reveals a past romantic connection with Jim's wife, leading to Dwight's confrontational remarks.

evidence.snippet: Danny: Oh, you know…funny. Your wife and I went on a few dates.
Dwight: Let me handle this, Jim. Drop the act, Cordray, okay? We all know that you probably thought that Pam was too "meh" or thin without being toned.

beats.summary: Dwight welcomes Danny to the team after some tension, and Michael reflects on stealing a sale from Danny.

evidence.snippet: Michael: This morning, Danny Cordray stole a sale from me. So what do I do? I go out and I steal Danny Cordray.
